name: Granola
tagline: AI meeting notepad that turns transcripts into structured notes
pricingNotes: Official page checked 2026-07-30 showed Business at $14/user/month and Enterprise from $35/user/month; older Individual $18 references may be stale.
verdictSummary: A local recorder plus Whisper transcription plus an LLM note template covers the core personal loop in one sitting. The paid product is mainly polish, meeting context, sync, and team workflow.
coreLoopDIY: Record system/mic audio, transcribe with Whisper or a hosted speech API, send transcript plus your rough notes to an LLM, save Markdown notes by date and meeting title.
requirements: macOS or Windows audio capture library | OpenAI/Anthropic API key or local Whisper model | local folder or SQLite database
whatYouLose: calendar awareness | mobile/cross-device sync | polished sharing | team libraries | enterprise controls
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because it is always on, nicely integrated with calendar/work calls, and trustworthy enough not to lose meeting history.
priorArtNote: Core transcription engine for a DIY local-first meeting-notes app.

name: Otter.ai

requirements: speech-to-text API or local Whisper | storage/search index | calendar/video-call integration if bot-style capture is desired
whatYouLose: live bot joining meetings | speaker diarization quality | mobile apps | team/admin controls | searchable account history | integrations
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for capture reliability and shared searchable meeting memory, not just the transcript file.
priorArtNote: Open-source transcription alignment and diarization tooling useful for DIY Otter-like workflows.
